<div class="card-body">
'''Wrong Turn''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">行き止まり</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して、場の相手の側に配備する。相手の戦士の配備コストはすべて＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-232o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の兵員は、逃亡者を分断し、立ち往生させる戦術を取った。ルークとレイアが切り抜けるには、勇気と大胆な行動力が必要だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dead End.

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your opponent's side of the table. All of your opponent's warriors are deploy +1.

'''Lore:''' Imperial troopers used tactics that separated fugitives and left them stranded. Luke and Leia would need courage and bold action to get through.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Wrong Turn]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
